text_block_list.text:
The sky was overcast before the race,
but now it's
bright and sunny.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: That was amazing. You did so well!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
To think I would receive this amount of
praise and
congratulations...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: Look at what you just did! You deserve it all!

text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I feel as though I finally
understand now.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
What sort of objective I had actually
set...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: And the joy of accomplishing it.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Yes... more than I could possibly put into
words!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
At times I felt troubled and wrestled
with
self-doubt. But I never gave in, and
for that, I am
happy.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Happy to be the first Mejiro to achieve
victory in
the Twin Tenno Sho!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
